name: False Confidence
overview: Scripture warns against placing confidence in self, human strength, or outward resources, as seen in the folly of building the tower of Babel to make a name for themselves. Trusting in chariots, horses, or weapons is described as vain and insufficient for true safety or deliverance. Instead, believers are called to remember and rely on the name of the LORD, recognizing that no king or mighty man is saved by earthly power alone.
